title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, empowering all users with advanced capabilities for enhanced productivity and deeper insights.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your content's embedded files, gaining comprehensive control over their appearance, with quick options to upload, download, and remove files directly within the editor.

title: Our New Public Product Roadmap is Here!
summary: Our brand-new public roadmap page is now available, offering a clear view into what we've recently accomplished, what's coming next, and our long-term vision for the product.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a more intuitive and visually cohesive workflow with our newly designed checkboxes, now easier to click and drag within your content.

title: Real-time Collaboration, Refined
summary: Experience a significantly enhanced editor where working with others is now more intuitive, insightful, and effortlessly in sync.

title: Supercharged Collaboration: Enhanced Shared Items
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and utilize shared items, empowering you and your connections to collaborate more effectively and unlock new levels of productivity.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko is now open source, offering unparalleled transparency and empowering our community to directly contribute to its evolution.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support to users worldwide.

title: Elevated Visuals: Polished Themes and Fresh Styles
summary: Elevate your workspace with a suite of stunning new themes and polished classics, designed to offer unparalleled personalization and aesthetic appeal.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Graph
summary: Explore your knowledge like never before with new filtering options and the ability to visualize shared connections, making your personal graph an indispensable tool.

title: Powerful Search & Curated Collections
summary: Unlock a new level of discovery with enhanced search capabilities, allowing you to precisely filter, sort, and save personalized collections of your knowledge for effortless retrieval.

title: Dynamic Note Previews & Enhanced Linking
summary: We're launching dynamic note previews and enhanced linking options, allowing you to structure and visualize your information in ways that truly reflect your thinking.

title: Unlock Noeko: Choose Your Hosting and Plan
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko with flexible new options for self-hosting and cloud-based paid plans, empowering you with greater control and advanced features.

title: Smarter Time Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience as we refine our greetings to perfectly match the current time of day, enhancing your interaction with our platform.

title: Enhanced Tag View Actions
summary: Experience enhanced productivity with the ability to swiftly remove items from tags and perform other essential actions in bulk, directly within the tag view.

title: Integrate Diverse Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate a broad spectrum of content, including videos, web pages, and text, empowering you to consolidate and interact with all your valuable information directly within the platform.
